name: Threadening
source:
You run a blog dedicated to urban legends and forgotten myths. When a friend tells you about a place where people have mysteriously vanished across generations, your curiosity takes over.

Drawn to the eerie charm of the area, you stumble upon an old, family-run bookstore and meet a mysterious, striking young man who might know more than he lets on. 

But wait… was that a cat disappearing around the corner? Will you follow it? Some threads, once pulled, can’t be undone.

[From [url=https://gepellt.itch.io/threadening]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你经营一个致力于都市传说和被遗忘的神话的博客。当朋友告诉你一个地方，那里的人已经神秘地消失了几代人，你的好奇心就会占据上风。

你被这个地区的怪异魅力所吸引，偶然发现了一家古老的家族经营书店，并遇到了一位神秘而引人注目的年轻人，他可能知道的比他表现出来的还要多。

但是等等……那是一只猫消失在拐角处吗？你会跟随吗？有些线索一旦拉动，就无法撤消。

[来自[url=https://gepellt.itch.io/threadening]Itch.io[/url]]
